abstract: The fixture (1) has a clamping unit (48) for releasably fixing a plugged-in connecting piece (23). The clamping unit is arranged at a plug receptacle (38) in a resiliently movable manner to hold a suction unit (6) on an outer circumference (47) of the plugged-in connecting piece lying close to clamping elements (54) under prestress. The clamping unit is provided with a manually operable release unit (55), which is liftable by an operation of the clamping elements to release the suction unit from the plugged-in connecting piece.
